## Quotes

> "He was so small for his years upon his arrival here. Truly, I scarcely recognized him today. He is starting to resemble his father quite a bit."
>

> "I have no doubt that Odette will perform her duty"
>

> "Is that not Cedric Stanhope who has become such a large boy?"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)

> "Indeed, I am uncertain"
>

> "He might be. They Americans are completely unpredictable"
>
> — Gorham Pullen — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P13](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0013)
